gas_dist_grp_design_page.title: DESIGN OF GAS PIPELINES AND GRP
gas_dist_grp_design_page.meta_title: Design of Gas Pipelines and Gas Regulation Points (GRP)
gas_dist_grp_design_page.meta_description: Design documentation development for distribution gas pipelines and gas regulation stations. Surveys, feasibility studies, cost calculation
gas_dist_grp_design_page.meta_h1: Gas Regulation Point for Industrial Customers. Gas Distribution Networks. Design, Approvals, Expert Examination. Cost Calculation
gas_dist_grp_design_page.about_p1: The design department of LLC Energy Plus has been successfully executing a full range of linear facility engineering works for more than two decades across all types of construction (new construction, reconstruction, overhaul, technical retrofitting, preservation, decommissioning).
gas_dist_grp_design_page.about_sub: Over years of operation, we have accumulated extensive experience in technical solutions for the relocation (re-routing) of operating gas pipelines conflicting with road construction and other capital structures. Our portfolio also includes numerous proven solutions for implementing protective measures (casing sleeves) on operating gas lines.
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item1: gas supply scheme calculations, gas equipment sizing and selection
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item2: development of route plans and longitudinal profiles (1:1000, 1:500, 1:100)
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item4: development of work execution plans (WEP) for trenchless crossings (HDD, microtunneling, auger boring)
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item6: selection of pre-engineered factory-built GRP, GRU, SHRP stations
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item7: selection and calculation of fiscal gas metering stations
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item8: cathodic corrosion protection (cathodic protection stations, sacrificial anodes)
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item9: gas hazard monitoring and detection system design
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_item10: supervisory control and telemetry dispatch system design
gas_dist_grp_design_page.tech_software: Specialized CAD and 3D modeling software is utilized throughout the design workflow, producing precise 2D drafting and comprehensive 3D spatial visualizations. 3D modeling delivers superior design accuracy and significantly accelerates statutory approvals and project commissioning.
gas_dist_grp_design_page.services_item1: collection and preparation of all required statutory baseline and permitting documentation;
gas_dist_grp_design_page.services_item3: development and statutory approval of design documentation with authorities such as JSC Mosgaz, JSC Mosoblgaz, PJSC Gazprom, and regional gas distributors
gas_dist_grp_design_page.services_compliance: Design documentation is developed in strict accordance with the Terms of Reference, Government Decree No. 87 requirements, including technical support through state expert review until positive conclusion approval.
gas_dist_grp_design_page.docs_work_doc: Detailed working documentation and designer's supervision are delivered to the exact scope necessary for premium quality execution of construction and installation works.
